visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up shot of a woman with her hair tied back, wearing a white sports bra and a beige towel draped over her neck. She appears exhausted, with sweat on her face, pedaling a spinning bike in a dark studio lit by faint red and green neon outlines. (2) The scene shifts to a medium-high angle showing the woman pedaling more intensely as variety-style text overlays appear. In the background, other participants are visible on spinning bikes, moving in rhythm under the dim, colorful lighting. (3) A young man with blonde hair, wearing a white tank top, is shown standing on a central stage platform at the fitness studio. He holds a handheld microphone and speaks to the class, surrounded by neon 'Space' signage. (4) Returning to a close-up, the woman on the bike smiles and looks toward the camera, her chest heaving from the exertion. She adjusts the towel around her neck while maintaining a steady pedaling pace. (5) A rapid montage shows the entire class cycling in sync to the music. The lighting shifts to vibrant purple and blue hues with strobing effects, creating a high-energy club-like atmosphere in the gym. (6) A static promotional graphic is overlaid on the video, featuring a portrait of the blonde man (Cheng En) and the title of his new song '1天1% Day'. (7) The woman films herself in a studio mirror, showing she has stopped pedaling. She reaches out her hand toward Cheng En, who is still on the stage with a microphone, and they share a brief greeting. (8) The final scene takes place in a brightly lit indoor hallway or lobby. Cheng En, now wearing a light blue denim jacket over his white tank top, hands a white paper gift bag to the woman; both are smiling and talking directly to the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with the sound of heavy, rapid female breathing and the muffled background hum of a gym. A female voice complains about being tired. No music is present yet. (2) A high-energy electronic dance track starts abruptly with a strong 4/4 beat. A male voice shouts 'Go!' and other encouraging phrases with high vocal intensity and arousal over the pulsing rhythm. (3) The music volume ducks significantly to make room for a clear male narration. The speaker uses a friendly and professional tone to explain his tradition of holding annual birthday parties for his friends. (4) A 'whoosh' transition sound effect occurs, followed by the female voice groaning in exhaustion. The background music swells back up, featuring heavy synth pads and electronic percussion. (5) A fast-tempo rock song with male vocals (Van Fan's 'Wu Le Bu Zuo') takes over the mix. Sounds of a crowd cheering and shouting 'Go!' are layered over the driving guitar riffs and drums. (6) The music remains steady as the narrator returns, speaking enthusiastically about the release of his new single. His voice is clear with moderate pitch variability. (7) The music fades out into casual conversational sounds, including laughter and the clinking of bags. A high-pitched 'ding' sound effect emphasizes a gift-giving moment, ending with friendly farewells.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents creator Hannah's attendance at a friend's (Cheng En) birthday-themed spinning class at Space Cycle. It serves as both a lifestyle vlog showcasing a fun community event and a promotional piece for Cheng En's new music release, using the high-energy fitness environment to create an engaging narrative.
